body.voice_description: Design an original approachable chess-coach voice. A light young-adult male voice with a contemporary northern English accent, clean forward tone and easy conversational rhythm. Bright attention and quiet good humor, with practical clear phrasing that settles on each idea. Naturally expressive but grounded, like a thoughtful friendly teammate. No low booming authority, breathy mysticism, squeaky cartoon voice, exaggerated elastic vowels, nasal comedy or silliness. Fluent English at a normal conversational teaching pace, about eight to ten seconds. Clear words and a fully finished final phrase. Clean dry studio sound, one voice, no music or animal noises. An original fictional voice, never an imitation of a named actor or character.
body.text: Notice what changed. That piece lost its defender. The other side can take it now. Keep the idea simple: look after your pieces.

encoding.method: SoundFile float64 decode; arithmetic channel mean; band-limited FFT resample to 48000 Hz; libsndfile Ogg Opus at compression level 0.93
